# TetrapodDot

Module: **QuantumDots** · directory: `QuantumDots/src/Programs` · binary: `QuantumDots/src/Programs/TetrapodDot`

```text
Tetrapod dot, version 0.01

Usage: Tetrapod dot [options] 

Options:

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

potential options:
    -M, --M-cell : number of cells in the x direction (default value = 100)
    -N, --N-cell : number of cells in the y direction (default value = 100)
    -H, --H-cell : number of cells in the z direction (default value = 100)
    -c, --cell-size : cell size in Angstrom (default value = 5)
    --below : height of the barrier just below the tetrapod (in cell unit) (default value = 0)
    --dot-radius : radius of the spherical dot in Angstrom unit (default value = 40)
    --arm-length : length of the four arms in Angstrom unit (default value = 80)
    --arm-radius : radius of the arm in Angstrom unit (default value = 20)
    --dot : potential in the dot (default value = -3)

Hilbert space options:
    --mu-x : electron effective mass in x direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 0.10000000000000001)
    --mu-y : electron effective mass in y direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 0.10000000000000001)
    --mu-z : electron effective mass in z direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 0.10000000000000001)
    --nbr-statex : number of states in x direction (default value = 31)
    --lowx : lower impulsion in x direction (default value = -15)
    --nbr-statey : number of states in y direction (default value = 31)
    --lowy : lower impulsion in y direction (default value = -15)
    --nbr-statez : number of states in z direction (default value = 31)
    --lowz : lower impulsion in z direction (default value = -15)

Lanczos options:
    -n, --nbr-eigen : number of eigenvalues (default value = 200)
    -e, --eigenstate : evaluate eigenstates
    --iter-max : maximum number of lanczos iteration (default value = 5000)
    -d, --disk : enable disk resume capabilities
    -r, --resume : resume from disk datas
    -i, --nbr-iter : number of lanczos iteration (for the current run) (default value = 500)
    --nbr-vector : maximum number of vector in RAM during Lanczos iteration (default value = 400)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help
    -v, --verbose : verbose mode

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
